text:
You need someone who can turn data into clear, decision-ready analysis and explain the findings in a way your team can act on.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. While my background is centered on analytics rather than broad machine learning engineering, I’m comfortable working with structured data, building reproducible analysis workflows, and presenting results clearly in a way that supports product and business decisions.

In my Parent survey analysis project for Riverbend Education Fund, I cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response parent survey and wrote the findings for the board. That work helped surface 3 findings that were adopted in the next funding plan. I focused on making the data trustworthy first, then translating the analysis into plain language that stakeholders could use.

In my Subscription churn cohorts project for a SaaS client, I built monthly retention curves by signup cohort and plan, plus a funnel of onboarding steps using SQL, PostgreSQL, Python, pandas, and Looker Studio. One onboarding step was linked to 40% of first-month churn, which gave the client a clear place to focus attention.

For your machine learning role, I understand you’re looking for experience with Python, AI frameworks, and generative AI tools such as GPT and LangChain. I want to be transparent that my strongest experience is in data analysis, cleaning, and visualization, not in building machine learning models or deep learning systems. If your need includes strong analytical support around model inputs, data preparation, reporting, dashboards, or operational analysis, I can contribute there effectively.

I’m detail-oriented, comfortable with messy data, and used to working from raw datasets to finished deliverables that stakeholders can understand. If helpful, I can also support the data side of your ML workflow by organizing datasets, validating outputs, and building clear reporting around performance or usage trends.

What part of this role is most important for you right now: Python-based model development, or the data analysis and reporting work around the ML system?
